description: This file implements context management for conversations, including token estimation, sliding window truncation, and conditional condensation based on token thresholds. It provides functions to manage conversation context by condensing or truncating messages to stay within token limits, with fallback mechanisms and telemetry integration.

methods.name: estimateTokenCount
methods.description: Estimates the number of tokens in given content using the provided API handler.

methods.name: truncateConversation
methods.description: Performs non-destructive sliding window truncation by tagging messages as hidden and inserting a truncation marker.

methods.name: willManageContext
methods.description: Determines whether context management (condensation or truncation) will likely be triggered based on token usage and thresholds.

methods.name: manageContext
methods.description: Main function to conditionally condense or truncate conversation messages to stay within token limits, with fallback mechanisms.
